data.outcome_summary: This OECD Greece country note (published June 2025) provides an overview of how the adult skills system is governed, within an OECD review covering 38 OECD countries. It describes a combined governance model in Greece, where national ministries and agencies design and monitor policy, while responsibilities for vocational education and training (VET) and lifelong learning are increasingly devolved to regional and local levels. The note specifies which institutions are responsible for strategy, intelligence, implementation, funding, and delivery across policy areas including VET, continuous education and training (CET), adult education (AE), and active labour market policies (ALMPs). It also reports the share of general government expenditure at the sub-national level (3.4%) and explains reforms in 2020 and 2024 that strengthened regional and municipal roles. No student assessment instruments, sampling, scaling, or PV-based benchmarks are used because the focus is institutional governance rather than learning outcomes.
